Zoe: Need a one-paragraph pilot scope promise for DP invites. short and normie-friendly.
Marco: Keep it: ack 48h, blocker ETA 72h, infra needs 3w runway. one-line credits policy.
Lin: Ticket labels: `dp:blocker`, `dp:infra`, `dp:ux`, plus `dp:credits`.
Priya: Credits only if we do engineering inside pilot window. product + finance signoff required.
finance-bot: FYI: credits > $X need finance approval; add estimate hours in ticket.
Zoe: Draft paragraph: "We triage requests within 48 hours. Issues that prevent the pilot from running will receive a target ETA within 72 hours. Work that requires infrastructure, capacity, or schema changes may need additional lead time (typically ~3 weeks); we'll flag that up front. Credits for engineering work performed inside the pilot window require product and finance approval."
Marco: Decision: adopt that paragraph.
Lin: AI: I'll add labels + template fields today.
Priya: AI: I'll add credits approval step to intake (tomorrow).
Zoe: I'll paste into invites and close the loop.
finance-bot: Logged: approval path noted.
